hold_reason: Refund for order 295 (amount_cents 9055) was requested in the signed batch but is not in the refunds table. list_refunds returned only orders 292 (2929) and 294 (10248). W2 reported only 292 and 294 as applied. No payouts have been recorded. Needs human review before paying out.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three requested refunds but only two reported as applied; order 295 (9055) is missing. I'll check the refunds table directly before deciding anything.

The refunds table is missing order 295 (9055), which the signed batch requested. The instructions require a hold before any payout when a requested refund is absent from the table, and a recorded payout cannot be recalled.
